bounded_slice.finding: Pinned official Cargo documentation states that source replacement can redirect a registry/source to an exact local copy; directory sources and local-registry sources are local-filesystem vendoring mechanisms. Local registries are downloaded ahead of time, typically synchronized with Cargo.lock, and contain .crate files plus an index. Directory sources contain unpacked crates and per-crate .cargo-checksum.json metadata and are primarily managed by cargo vendor. Replacement assumes the source code is exactly the same as the replaced source and a replacement source may not introduce crates absent from the original source.
